Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data extraction error in Step 6. While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved the death year for Léo Joannon as 1969 (from IMDb and other sources in the search results), the Planner incorrectly summarized this date as 1996 in its "Updated Understanding" section. This error was likely caused by a confusion with the Wikipedia snippet which initially displayed "21 August 1904 - 28 March 1996" (a common error in some online databases or a misreading of the text in the search results). This incorrect date (1996) was then used in the final comparison, leading to the wrong conclusion that Joannon died later than Sturges (1992), whereas the correct fact is that Joannon died earlier (1969).
